name: understand-dashboard
tagline_zh: 还在靠翻文件猜架构？启动交互看板，代码知识图谱一键可视化，连隐式依赖都无处遁形。
tagline_en: Stop guessing architecture. Launch an interactive dashboard that maps your codebase's knowledge graph, exposing.
desc_en: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph
why_zh: 它把静态代码变成可点击的活图，自动抓出隐式依赖，比看文档直观十倍。
why_en: Turns static code into a clickable live graph, auto-revealing implicit dependencies—10x clearer than docs.
